tour.launch: Guided tour: light your first truss step by step

common.pwaTag: Simulator tools (PWA) — not part of the Quartz desk

desk.hiLight: Hi Light — boosts the selected fixtures to full (latched; not stored in the programmer). Click to toggle.
desk.fan: Fan — fan mode: while on, turn a wheel and the attribute spreads across the selection (the centre stays). Click to toggle.
desk.patch: Patch — opens the Patch menu and the patch panel (PWA)
desk.viewOpen: View/Open — opens Workspaces: recall a saved layout or record the current one (Record Workspace)
desk.prevCue: Prev Cue — previous step of the connected playback
desk.nextCue: Next Cue — next step of the connected playback
desk.go: Go — advances the connected playback to the next cue
desk.fixtureKey: Fixture — selection (the fixtures window is on the right)
desk.avo: avo (Avolites) — second functions (the blue ones). On the real Quartz you HOLD it while pressing another key; here it latches (click to toggle).
desk.time: Time — Go fade: {{secs}}s (click to change; 0 = Snap)
desk.clear: Clear — empties the programmer and deselects
desk.exit: Exit — back to the root menu / clear the line
desk.execFixed: Executor {{n}} — {{label}} (fixed function; not in the simulator yet)
desk.flashKey: {{label}} · key {{key}} (hold to flash; several at once)
desk.swopKey: {{label}} · key {{key}} (hold to swop). Caps Lock + key = executor.
desk.flashName: Flash {{name}} — {{state}}. On the real Quartz it's momentary (hold); here it's a toggle.
desk.swopName: Swop {{name}} — {{state}}. On the real Quartz it's momentary; here it's a toggle.
desk.connect: Connect/Cue — connects a playback to the central transport without firing it
desk.connectArmed: Connect armed — touch a playback to connect it to the central Go (without firing)
desk.execRecordHere: Executor {{n}} — click to record the current look here
desk.execLabelPrompt: Executor {{n}} — type its label (empty to clear)
desk.setLegendPick: touch an item to rename it
desk.maskActive: Record Mask active — only the shown banks are stored when you Record
desk.fileInvalid: That file isn't a valid show.
desk.newShowPrompt: New Show — name for the new show (leave empty to cancel):
desk.addWindow: Open another mosaic window (up to 4 — like the Titan touchscreen)
desk.winPopout: Send to a new window (2nd monitor)
desk.winToExt: Send to the external monitor (2nd display)
desk.winToMain: Bring back to the main screen
desk.extEmpty: External monitor connected. Send windows here from the main screen with ⤢ (on a window bar, or the visualiser).

patch.title: Patch
patch.addTrussHint: Add a truss to the rig
patch.rig: Rig layout — drag to position on the truss
patch.readdressHint: Reorder fixtures left→right and re-assign DMX addresses, as a real rig is patched (address follows the cable run)
patch.empty: No fixtures yet — add one from the library.
patch.name: Name
patch.barTip: Like Titan (DMX Line / Address / Quantity). Universe = the DMX line/output (1–4), NOT the truss (choose the truss by dragging the fixture when rigging it). Address blank = auto (next free); Qty patches several already spaced and the address auto-advances.
patch.spaceTip: Space the fixtures shown evenly across the truss width

program.title: Programmer
program.placeholder: Programmer, groups, palettes, cues and playback land in phase 2.
program.selectHint: Select fixtures in the visualizer or patch list, then adjust channels.

visualizer.title: Visualizer
visualizer.note: 2D top view now; 3D (Three.js) in a later phase.
visualizer.aimTip: Aim the fixture by hand (physical rigging — not DMX).
visualizer.hide: Close the visualiser (reopen from Open/View → Visualiser)
visualizer.pwaSim: simulator aids: effects Play/Pause, load a venue, room lights, 2D view and aiming PARs by hand
visualizer.pwaReal: the Quartz's visualiser (Capture) doesn't have these controls, or does them differently
visualizer.aimPad: Aim the fixture: the centre is straight down, drag toward where you want it to light (the edge = horizontal). Watch it in the 3D.
visualizer.popout: Send the visualiser to the external monitor (2nd display)

run.title: Run
run.empty: No cues yet. Program a look, then Record it.
run.recordHint: Cues snapshot the programmer. Record a look, Clear, then Go to play it back.

show.invalid: That file isn't a valid DMXSimulatoR show.

playbacks.tapTip: Tap Tempo — tap the beat a few times and the BPM follows
playbacks.pageTip: Which page of 10 the physical playback faders control. ◀ ▶ change page; tap the number to jump (Go Page).

audio.lineIn: The faithful option: on the real Quartz it's the built-in audio jack (line-in). Here it uses the computer's mic / line input.
audio.sysAudio: Only Chrome / Brave / Edge, sharing a TAB of the same browser (Safari/Firefox don’t allow it).
audio.demo: Sets up an example: records 2 looks with intensity (red/blue) and maps them to bass/treble. Load a track and turn the volume up to see it.
audio.bandEnable: Enable: turns this band’s trigger on/off
